name: CycleWire
summary: The reference page activated by CycleWire, built from this repository's source, so every run measures the commit it runs on: the core loads up front, and each interaction's code loads when someone reaches for it. Nothing hydrates.

idioms.choice: The core loads as a module in <head>, with a modulepreload link, as the performance guide recommends.
Vite bundles the page's script, and fromGlob(import.meta.glob('./actions/*.js')) registers every action as its own chunk. Vite preloads a chunk's dependencies when it is imported.

The server writes the entry's <script> and <link rel="modulepreload"> tags from Vite's manifest, and the modulepreload polyfill is turned off rather than imported, as the backend integration guide allows. Preloading an action's imports stays on.
Add to cart is preloaded when the browser is idle (cw-preload="idle"), since most visitors use it; everything else loads on intent, the default.
The cart header is bound to a store the server serializes (cw-store, cw-bind); cyclewire/signals arrives with the cart action.
The quick view fetches JSON and renders it with cyclewire/dom, which arrives with that action.
